title: Agent Manifest Schema
description: v3.0.0 Capability Contract — every agent declares its tools, memory tier, cost envelope, session type, and interop targets. BC-2: agents without a manifest block fail startup.

manifest_version.description: Manifest schema version. Only '1.0' is valid for v3.0.0.

agent_id.description: Unique agent identifier in lowercase-kebab-case. Must match the agent file name.

capabilities.description: Enumeration of tool permissions with optional rate limits.

allowed.description: Whether this tool is permitted for the agent.

rate_limit.description: Optional rate limit for this tool.

calls_per_task.description: Maximum number of calls allowed per task execution.

burst.description: Optional burst allowance above the per-task rate.

memory_tier.description: Memory persistence tier. STM = session-only, MTM = cross-session medium-term, LTM = permanent, NONE = stateless.

cost_envelope.description: Spending and token constraints for this agent. Integrates with token-governor and spend-guard.

max_tokens_per_task.description: Hard token ceiling per task execution. Enforced by token-governor.

max_usd_per_session.description: Maximum USD spend allowed per session. Enforced by spend-guard.

preferred_model.description: Preferred model for cost/capability trade-off. 'inherit' defers to router config.

session_type.description: Session lifecycle. ephemeral = no state survives; persistent = state survives across sessions; delegated = lifecycle managed by parent orchestrator.

supports_mcp.description: Whether this agent speaks MCP Streamable HTTP (v3.0.0 transport).

supports_aip_tokens.description: Whether this agent validates AIP invocation-bound capability tokens (arXiv 2603.24775).

supports_maf.description: Whether this agent exports a Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0-compatible agent card.

maf_input_modes.description: MAF inputModes field — modalities this agent can accept.

maf_output_modes.description: MAF outputModes field — modalities this agent can produce.

schema_upgrade_hint.description: Present when manifest_version is behind the current schema. Contains upgrade instructions.
